column2: the collection method is recorded on EVERY sample line and is never substituted mid-row; two methods are reported side by side and never averaged or swapped

kernel loopback interface counters read through /proc/<subject pid>/net/dev, which reports that pid's network NAMESPACE. On this host that namespace is the host's, so the scope is HOST-WIDE, not fixture-wide; the row measures an idle baseline to quantify what is not this fixture

per-connection UDP datagram byte totals from the source-pinned transport (quinn 0.11.11 / quinn-proto 0.11.17, pinned in Cargo.lock). Fixture-scoped by construction because they belong to one connection; one-sided, being this endpoint's view

every datagram on lo is counted once in that interface's RX and once in its TX, so an interface delta is TWICE the wire bytes. The row reports the raw delta and the halved figure side by side and never silently halves

handshake, TLS and retry bytes are measured in their own phase, before any payload exists, and recorded separately from logical payload bytes. Retransmission is reported from the transport's own lost_packets/lost_bytes counters
logical payload bytes (4194304) are recorded as their own number and COMPARED with measured transport bytes; no network figure in this row is derived from a payload size

the row proves its own detection: a deliberately truncated copy of the network artifact must be REJECTED by the validating reader, a record with no stated method must be rejected, and a counter read against a non-existent interface must fail rather than return zero
